ADVICEsama/CivitaiFreeTool.body:
### One workbench for your models.

Download · Organize · Check for updates · Reverse parsing · Workflow analysis

**[Download Windows version ↗](https://github.com/ADVICEsama/CivitaiFreeTool/releases/tag/v3.0.25)** / **[Explore official website ↗](https://advicesama.github.io/CivitaiFreeTool/)** / [Report issues](https://github.com/ADVICEsama/CivitaiFreeTool/issues)

Windows 10 / 11 · Portable app · Light / dark themes

---

## From links to collections, without constantly switching tools.

CivitaiFreeTool connects Civitai / Hugging Face model downloads, local archiving, and generation info analysis into one workbench. The browser handles discovery, while CFT handles receiving, organizing, and viewing.

| Collect & manage | Sources & process | Your usage habits |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Batch links → download queue → batched history | Hash reverse lookup, same-base-model version checks | Light/dark themes, font fallback, and shortcuts |
| Waterfall / grid / list, favorites & filtering | Real node connections, prompts and referenced models | Four performance levels, background resource reduction |

**Current stable version 3.0.25** · Chrome extension 1.3.1 · Firefox extension 1.3.2

> Ten languages are in preview: currently only onboarding and navigation are covered; other pages are not yet fully translated. Screenshots in this document use isolated sample data and do not include personal models, accounts, or tasks.

## 3.0.25 Update

The model management waterfall moves the content of cards outside one screen above and below the viewport into off-screen storage, while keeping box heights and positions unchanged. When a wheel scroll jumps to the middle or end, the slowest single frame drops from 422–894 ms to 74–156 ms, with no blank cards appearing. It also fixes a page error caused by reading waterfall image sizes before configuration has loaded at startup. For details, see the [release notes](https://github.com/ADVICEsama/CivitaiFreeTool/blob/HEAD/docs/releases/v3.0.25.md).

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

STAR-10086/buct-one.body:
# BUCT One · One-Stop BUCT

**Native Liquid Glass campus workspace for Beijing University of Chemical Technology (BUCT)**

A native Android campus client for BUCT students and staff. Sign in once through the school's unified identity authentication, and connect timetables, home-screen widgets, grades and training plans, course selection and enrollment rush, BUCT Online, Second Classroom five-dimensional evaluation, practice teaching, fitness tests and physical education, campus email, and campus smart card. Local-first, with zero third-party reporting.

[Official download (buct.one)](https://buct.one) · [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/STAR-10086/buct-one/releases) · [Changelog (CHANGELOG)](https://github.com/STAR-10086/buct-one/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md) · [Upstream notice (NOTICE)](https://github.com/STAR-10086/buct-one/blob/HEAD/NOTICE) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/STAR-10086/buct-one/blob/HEAD/docs/规划.md) · [Data layer design](https://github.com/STAR-10086/buct-one/blob/HEAD/docs/plan-1-data-layer.md) · [Signing integration](https://github.com/STAR-10086/buct-one/blob/HEAD/docs/签名接入.md)

---

## Design Philosophy

- **One login, linked across sites**: Fully native Kotlin implementation of `sidportal.buct.edu.cn` unified identity authentication (SM2/AES, SMS second-factor verification, Passkey/WebAuthn, no WebView login). After a single login, passwordless direct access to academic affairs, BUCT Online, Second Classroom, practice teaching, fitness and sports, and campus email. A cross-module `SsoSilentRelogin` coordinator single-flights silent renewal when sessions expire.
- **Hybrid on-campus/off-campus DNS resolution (`BuctDns`)**: Second Classroom, which is limited to on-campus or VPN access, prefers a direct connection to the on-campus DNS `202.4.130.100`. Other on-campus services prefer the system DNS and fall back on failure, balancing the experience for access from on and off campus.
- **Local-first, offline-capable**: All snapshots are written atomically to disk per domain. Under four data-layer rules, a failed sync never clears the existing cache, so timetables, grades, assignments, email, and home-screen widgets are always readable.
- **Privacy and security baseline**: All third-party analytics and telemetry are disabled. Credentials the user opts to remember locally are encrypted with `Android Keystore` (AES-256-GCM) under separate aliases and are explicitly excluded from cloud backup and device transfer. In-memory `char[]` buffers are zeroed after use, and the school's certificate chain is strictly validated across the network (`BuctTlsTrustManager`).

ShaneLiu04/Step-RL.description: An LLM Agent long-horizon decision optimization system based on reinforcement learning
ShaneLiu04/Step-RL.body:
# Step-RL v4.16

**Validator-driven hierarchical reinforcement learning for on-device Web Agents**

> Toward self-evolution: capability gating discovers uncovered tasks → a real LLM fallback succeeds once → trajectories are automatically induced into parameterized skills → thereafter similar tasks use **0 LLM**.  
> Remove task: **uncovered** before induction, **3/3** after induction (across products/layouts + ID churn), 0 prompt tokens;  
> **Batch removal**: a single instruction with 2–3 products, skill path **3/3**, 0 LLM; single-product removal does not regress.  
> **Skill statistics and priority**: skill success/failure is recorded using validator criteria; when the success rate drops, the skill is retired to yield (0/1 → explicit gap → LLM fallback → closed-loop re-induction), and afterward similar tasks use **0 LLM**.  
> **Order status query**: real order page + server-side status predicates (valid/cancelled), LLM fallback **1 step / 186 tokens** consolidated into a 1-step skill; similar instructions **3/3, 0 LLM** (including cancelled-state transition + v2 layout + ID churn).  
> **Coupon-constrained planning**: threshold-discount coupons become first-class constraints on par with budget; feasibility is judged against the real coupon list + live prices (infeasible → explicit None, no guessing, no downgrading), with server-authoritative discount settlement; similar instructions **8/8 planning + 3/3 execution, 0 LLM**.  
> **Concurrent session isolation**: 4 real Edge sessions executing concurrently against a shared real server, **4/4 succeeded with zero cross-talk** (2.75× parallelism); 4 real DOM failures recorded **4/4 exactly**; 10×12 concurrent writers **0 corrupted**.  
> **Adaptive observation cache**: single round-trip snapshot + DOM revision-number cache, still **30/30, 0 LLM** across 30 scenarios; observation round-trips **−62.7%**, observation time **−63.0%**.  
> **Layout-adaptive skill compilation**: under v3 fresh DOM/controls (searchbox, find, no id, quantity stepper), fixed skills **1/3** → LASC **3/3, 0 LLM**; v1/v2 30/30 with zero regression.  
> **Shopping-cart transaction compilation**: double all items / uniformly change quantities / add one per item, baseline **0/3** → CTC **3/3, 0 LLM**; under a real update failure, already-changed items were rolled back, **compensated=1**.

---

> **Read the value ledger first**: [What 27 AR attempts delivered](#ar-价值总览27-次尝试26-次进入最优组合) ·
> [Full AR value matrix](#ar-价值矩阵全部尝试) · [EX002 stress experiment](https://github.com/ShaneLiu04/Step-RL/blob/HEAD/docs/results/EX002_report.md)

blacksunshy/coopanion-fatfish.description: Coopanion/Cortico voice extension: speaks the pet's replies aloud with a chosen Edge TTS voice
blacksunshy/coopanion-fatfish.body:
# cortico-world-fatfish · Big Fatfish feature bundle

The Cortico World extension for the Coopanion desktop pet. In one sentence: **Talk to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and have it do work and write code for you; when the pet replies, the built-in voice pack reads it aloud.**

> ⚠️ **Security notice (DSH side):** If you also use the `coopanion-connector-dsh` Host plugin on the DSH side, upgrade it to **v0.2.12** (GitHub distribution only: `https://github.com/blacksunshy/coopanion-connector-dsh`). Older versions below 0.2.9 have a CSWSH security vulnerability: any web page can craft a WS upgrade request to hijack the bridge between the desktop pet and DSH (vulnerability details are in issue #6 of the connector repo). **fatfish itself is not affected by this vulnerability, but both ends of the bridge must be upgraded together.** The session picker and "unpin" require **≥ 0.2.11**, and "new session" requires **≥ 0.2.12**.

- **Let DSH do the work:** Connect the desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness (DSH). When it hears you speak, it hands the request off to DSH for you. The work DSH does, the code it writes, the tools it calls, and the approvals it waits on all come back into the conversation as messages. Only lines without a receipt need the pet to relay them, and they are not handed off again after a restart.
- **Replies with sound:** Includes 19 built-in Edge TTS voices (Xiaoxiao, Yunxi, Northeastern Xiaobei, Shaanxi Xiaoni, Cantonese Xiaoman, Taiwanese Xiaozhen, Aria, Jenny, and others), plus a row of "voice pack" presets: a gentle female voice, a lively girl voice, a news-anchor style, Northeastern and Shaanxi accents, Cantonese, Taiwanese accent, and English, one of each. Pick one and it sets the voice, speaking rate, pitch, and volume all at once. You can also choose "Custom" to set the voice, rate, pitch, and volume yourself. The pet reads its replies aloud as it responds, and when it asks a question, it reads the options along with it. Speech output works on Windows and macOS (Linux synthesis is available but has no playback channel yet).
- **Automatic handoff when the context is nearly full (from 0.6.20; requires connector ≥ 0.2.18; from 0.6.28, only trusted numbers are used):** DSH reports context usage at the end of each turn. At 90%, it automatically creates a new session, pins it, switches to it, and delivers a one-line handoff seed. If the Host does not report usage, it falls back to 400 turns. Each session is handed off at most once. From 0.6.28, the Host reads DSH's own `contextPressure` and ignores impossible occupancy values such as `used > size`. When a proxy model folds history upstream, the raw transcript can be longer than the window (measured 1.36M against a 1M window, actual usage 12.5%). Handing off based on that would switch away a session that was just started.
- **"Mouth-only" mode (from 0.6.20):** Once another world injects `globalThis.__cooPetSayRaw(text)`, approvals / answers / errors /…

ciskonc/ClashOmega.description: A Chrome browser extension developed based on Clash Verge Rev for managing Clash proxy rules. Tribute to SwitchyOmega / ZeroOmega. Supports three-mode proxy switching, domain rule match detection, one-click adding of domains to proxy groups, and YAML rule add/delete with hot reload.
ciskonc/ClashOmega.body:
# ClashOmega

> Chrome browser extension for managing Clash proxy rules. Tribute to SwitchyOmega / ZeroOmega.

[🌐 Website](https://magicalyuyu.github.io/ClashOmega/) · [Chinese](https://github.com/ciskonc/ClashOmega/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [English](https://github.com/ciskonc/ClashOmega/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/ciskonc/ClashOmega/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)

---

## Interface Preview

## Features

### Core Features

| Feature | Description |
|------|------|
| Three-mode switching | System proxy → Direct → Clash proxy, one-click switching, icon color changes in real time |
| Domain match detection | Detects the Clash rules matching the current domain, showing the matched group and policy (supports RULE-SET fallback via `/connections` API query) |
| Quick rule addition | Adds the current domain to a proxy group (dynamically fetches the Clash proxy group list) |
| Smart domain grouping | Detects all domains on the page and suggests automatic grouping (e.g., `i1.art.com`, `i2.art.com` → `*.art.com`) |
| System proxy status | Displays system proxy status in real time (Native Host reads the registry, with browser proxy API as fallback; compatible with some Chromium-based browsers) |
| Rule management | View, add, and delete rules in Clash YAML configuration files (automatically hot-reloaded after changes) |
| Restart Clash | One-click sync of profile rules to the Clash Verge Rev snapshot file and restart of the kernel (used when hot reload fails) |

## Installation

> ⚠ **Upgrading from v1.3.6 or earlier to v1.3.7+**: The extension ID is now fixed, so you **must re-run `native-host/install.ps1`** (press Enter to use the default ID). Otherwise the Native Host will fail to start due to an ID mismatch. See [v1.3.7 Release Notes](https://github.com/ciskonc/ClashOmega/releases/tag/v1.3.7).

#### 1. Load the Extension

1. Open `chrome://extensions/`
2. Enable “Developer mode” in the top-right corner
3. Click “Load unpacked extension”
4. Select the `extension/` directory

heropml/SerialTool.description: Serial debugging assistant and network debugging tool in one: UART + TCP/UDP + Virtual, with HEX, Modbus, log recording, PCAP export, scripting and automation (Windows / macOS)
heropml/SerialTool.body:
# CommTool — Serial Debugging Assistant + Network Debugging Tool

An open-source **serial debugging assistant / network debugging tool** that combines UART serial ports, SEGGER J-Link RTT, and TCP/UDP debugging in one desktop interface. It is aimed at embedded development, device integration, Modbus / custom protocol testing, and communication log analysis. Official release packages support **Windows**, **macOS**, and **Linux x86_64**.

> Serial / RTT terminal and TCP/UDP network debugger in one desktop app — HEX, logging, Modbus, scripting, and automated tests.

[Download latest version](https://github.com/heropml/SerialTool/releases) · [Chinese usage guide](https://github.com/heropml/SerialTool/blob/HEAD/docs/使用说明.md) · [English Usage](https://github.com/heropml/SerialTool/blob/HEAD/docs/USAGE.md)

CommTool (communication debugging tool) was merged from the original SerialTool and NetworkTool. Switch between **Serial / RTT / UDP / UDP Multicast / TCP Server / TCP Client / Virtual / BLE** using the top-left corner. The send/receive area, keyword highlighting, batch sending, recording and playback, and automation features are shared across all of them, so you no longer need a separate tool for serial, RTT, and network. **Product and release package name: CommTool**. The Git repository path remains `heropml/SerialTool` (the repository name was not changed, to avoid breaking update links).

**Suited for:** MCU / USB-to-serial debugging · TCP/UDP service integration · Modbus master/slave and scanning · periodic/batch commands · session logs and (limited-scope) PCAP export · reproducing issues with Virtual loopback when no hardware is available

javahongxi/jaws.description: Lightweight RPC framework with 140K QPS over TCP, a single port that adaptively serves bare TCP / HTTP/2 / HTTP/1.1, and a self-developed Wire protocol interoperable with gRPC
javahongxi/jaws.body:
# Jaws Framework 🦈

> Named after *Jaws* (《大白鲨》) — **J**ava **A**sync **W**ire **S**ervice: the Java ecosystem, asynchronous invocation, wire-level protocol, and service governance. These four words are exactly the four-layer anatomy of an RPC framework.

Jaws is a lightweight RPC framework with a **core of over 30,000 lines that you can read from start to finish**. At about 1/7 the code size of Dubbo's core skeleton, it fully implements the core mechanisms of an industrial-grade RPC. It supports Netty TCP and HTTP/2 multi-transport, peer-level interoperability with the gRPC wire format, three streaming call types, adaptive load balancing, and high-availability fault tolerance. Measured performance is about 140K QPS. The goal is to become a **benchmark for RPC skeletons**: after reading the Jaws source, reading Dubbo will be much faster.

## Features

- **Dual protocol support** — Provides two protocols: the jaws protocol, where Java interfaces are the contract, and the wire protocol, where IDL is the contract and which is peer-compatible with gRPC
- **Multi-transport support** — The jaws protocol supports two transports, Netty TCP and HTTP/2. HTTP/2 additionally supports three streaming call types
- **gRPC compatibility** — The wire protocol supports bidirectional interoperability with gRPC, has zero grpc-java dependencies, and supports unary and all three streaming call types
- **Adaptive transport** — TCP, HTTP/2, and HTTP/1.1 can coexist on a single port. The protocol is detected from the first byte and the corresponding protocol stack is assembled automatically, with zero resident overhead after detection
- **REST support** — Services expose REST interfaces over HTTP/1.1. Annotation-driven routing is compatible with Spring Web and JAX-RS, with generic invocation as a fallback
- **Multiple serialization formats** — Built-in fastjson2, hessian2, protostuff, and fury. The consumer specifies the serialization method, and the protocol header carries the serialization identifier
- **Connection heartbeat** — Periodic mutual heartbeats keep connections alive and prevent long-idle connections from being dropped by intermediate devices
- **Service registration and discovery** — ZooKeeper / Nacos registry centers. Supports long-lived session keep-alive and automatically rebuilds registration after a disconnect and reconnect
- **Multiple load balancing strategies** — random, roundRobin, leastActive, leastLoad, adaptive, consistentHash
- **High-availability fault tolerance** — failover (retry on failure), failfast (fail immediately), failsafe (fail safe)
- **Router chain / Router** — An extensible routing filter chain applied at invocation time, with built-in tag routing (canary release) and dynamic configuration routing
- **Connection warm-up** — The weight of a newly started Provider grows linearly over time, preventing it from being overwhelmed during cold start
- **Graceful shutdown** — Four-phase shutdown (deregister from the registry center → stop accepting requests → wait for in-flight requests → close connections) for zero-impact releases
- **Dynamic configuration** —…

lexifina/china-law.description: China: law history, one commit per law taking effect (sources so far) · Part of global law
lexifina/china-law.body:
# China: law history in git

**Simplified Chinese** · [English](https://github.com/lexifina/china-law/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

China's national laws presented as a git history: each article is one file, each version is one commit, and the date of each commit is the date that version takes effect. The author of each commit is the legal instrument that made that change. `git blame` shows the legal instrument behind each paragraph (款); `git log` lists all amendments to an article; choosing a date gives the text in effect on that day.

This repository is part of [lexifina/global-law](https://github.com/lexifina/global-law), which combines the laws of many countries into one git history. This is the part covering China's national laws; global-law reads them from `china/national/acts/`.

**Current contents:** the 1982 Constitution, amended five times, and 172 laws enacted by the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee. All are currently in force, for a total of 190 versions: Criminal Law has 15, Criminal Procedure Law has 3, Company Law and Labor Contract Law have 2 each, and the remaining 168 laws have 1 each. [`data/acts.json`](https://github.com/lexifina/china-law/blob/HEAD/data/acts.json) lists each law's folder, its versions, and their recorded starting points. Each law's folder contains a `README.md` listing its versions.

Each law is a folder in [`法律/`](https://github.com/lexifina/china-law/blob/HEAD/法律/), named after the law's Chinese title. Each article is a file (`法律/劳动合同法/第066条.md` is Article 66 of the 《中华人民共和国劳动合同法》). `目录.md` contains the titles of its parts and chapters, and `附件N.md` contains its appendices. The Constitution is in [`宪法/`](https://github.com/lexifina/china-law/blob/HEAD/宪法/), with the preamble at `宪法/序言.md`. Before 20 November 2026, these folders were named in pinyin and sat at the top level of the repository (`laodonghetongfa/art-066.md`). [`data/paths.json`](https://github.com/lexifina/china-law/blob/HEAD/data/paths.json) lists the new path for each old path, and `git log --follow` can trace each file across this move. Article numbers follow the current version. When an amendment changes article numbers, git shows the text as having moved between files.

The text is in Chinese, matching the version published by 中国人大网 (China NPC website), with full-width digits converted to ASCII digits. This record does not include English translations.

# Chromium Desktop for OHOS

A Chromium desktop browser HAP application project for **HarmonyOS / OHOS tablet and 2in1 devices**, currently integrating **Chromium 158.0.8116.0 / arm64 / API 26**.

**This repository continues development from the Chromium 132 HAP project at [Nyaacho0v0/chromium-2in1-hap](https://github.com/Nyaacho0v0/chromium-2in1-hap).** The original author and upstream community provided the app shell, system interface bridging, and packaging foundation. This project builds on that work by integrating the 158 kernel and making compatibility adaptations. Thanks to the original author and related contributors.

Original 132 baseline commit: [`cc241f6d431c52144afe58f3d4232ca7c9658c43`](https://github.com/Nyaacho0v0/chromium-2in1-hap/commit/cc241f6d431c52144afe58f3d4232ca7c9658c43). This repository retains the Git history of that baseline and the copyright and license notices in the files carried over from it.

## Companion kernel repositories

| Repository | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [chromium-ohos](https://github.com/nimmi114514/chromium-ohos) | Chromium 158 kernel and dependency adaptation patches, build tools, verification records |
| [chromium-desktop-ohos](https://github.com/nimmi114514/chromium-desktop-ohos) (this repository) | ArkTS app shell, system bridging, app configuration, and HAP packaging project |

This repository requires the native libraries, ICU, PAK language/UI resources, and V8 snapshot produced by compiling the companion kernel. **This HAP repository alone cannot build a complete browser.** First follow [Build the complete HAP from both repositories](https://github.com/nimmi114514/chromium-ohos#从两个仓库构建完整-hap) in the companion repository to fetch the pinned Chromium source and DEPS dependencies, apply the app patches, and compile the kernel, then package this project. No additional private sub-repositories from the author are needed.

The app version is currently `1.0.4`, managed separately from the Chromium kernel version `158.0.8116.0`. After updating the kernel, you must sync the resources and regenerate the HAP before the kernel on devices is updated.

opensophy-projects/NginxionS.description: Next-Generation Open Source Proxy & Application Security Platform
opensophy-projects/NginxionS.body:
# NginxionS

**Next-Generation Open Source Proxy & Application Security Platform**

A reverse proxy based on nginx with built-in protection: a machine-learning WAF, CrowdSec, its own certificate authority and mTLS, traffic analytics, and roles. Everything is configured in one interface and works without the cloud.

[**Documentation**](https://opensophy.com/) · [**Quick install**](#быстрая-установка) · [**Features**](#возможности) · [**Contacts**](#безопасность-и-контакты)

## Quick install

You need a Linux x86_64 server with Docker Engine 28+ and Compose 2.23+, free ports 80, 443 and 81, and about 10 GB of disk space. Docker 28+ is required for security: in older versions, the port published on `127.0.0.1` (the panel) could be reached by neighboring machines on the same local network.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/opensophy-projects/NginxionS nginxions && cd nginxions
docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d --pull always
docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml ps    # after 1–2 minutes all services are healthy
```

The panel (port `81`) listens only on `127.0.0.1` of the server by default, so it is not visible from the internet. Open it via an SSH tunnel and register the administrator:

prostoy23rus/zapret2wizard.description: ⚡ Autonomous DPI bypass wizard for Zapret2: OpenWrt LuCI web interface, Circular chains, Discord VoiceFlow and turbo strategy selection
prostoy23rus/zapret2wizard.body:
# Zapret2Wizard

**Autonomous DPI/TSPU bypass for OpenWrt:** the `zapret2 (nfqws2)` engine, a custom strategy scanner, selection tailored to a specific ISP, and a LuCI web interface. Installs as a single package, works without third-party dependencies and without internet access after installation.

---

## What it provides

- **Bypass works for all devices on the network** — phones, laptops, TVs. It is configured on the router; clients don't need to install anything.
- **The strategy is selected for your ISP.** There are no ready-made universal strategies: the scanner checks candidates with real downloads of up to 256 KB and applies only the one that actually passes traffic.
- **Bypass only where needed** — separate domain lists for YouTube, Discord, Twitch, X, Instagram, plus "Custom domains" and an exclusion list.
- **Does not conflict with tunnels** — the service runs in its own nft table and its own queues, does not write to other lists and does not stop other services; if a domain is routed into a tunnel, the selection process will honestly report it.
- **Self-diagnostics**: `doctor`, `selftest`, `class` — show what is broken and which filtering class the ISP uses.
- **Survives reboots**: autostart, recovery after selection, and self-restart of the service.

splanternQAQ/dsh-pixiv-Kindred-Gallery.body:
# Pixiv Kindred Gallery

**A local gallery for DeepSeek Harness: run a round → score → save to the library → learn your taste**

It doesn't process images itself. Searching, viewing, and downloading are handled by [刷Pixiv](https://github.com/splanternQAQ/dsh-pixiv-Kindred-Gallery) (`dsh-pixiv-scroll`). The gallery arranges the results as cards, lets you score them, and remembers your taste.

[Quick Start](#快速开始) · [What It Does](#它做什么) · [Security & Permissions](#安全与权限先读这一段) · [Where Data Lives](#数据放在哪) · [FAQ](#常见问题) · [Changelog](#更新日志倒序)

## What It Does

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Run a round** | Fetches a batch of candidates from pixiv based on target tags, favorite tags, and rating/threshold settings; AI picks out the cards. Supports running multiple rounds as a batch quota |
| **Scoring** | 0–10 points; low scores automatically go to the recycle bin. The original average and current average are recorded separately, and deleted works stay in the original average |
| **Works library** | Downloaded works are saved as `author/title_id`. Supports collections (three-tier pinning), tag filtering, image-only mode, pagination, and one-click 7z packaging |
| **Taste profile** | Samples high-scoring works to compute style and tag weights, showing what you like and what to avoid. It gets more accurate with use |
| **Gallery search** | Chat box in the top bar: ask about usage, paste a pid or link to look up works, or add them directly to the library. If you ask it to change settings, it actually does |
| **Sharing** | Right-click to copy images, one-click copy of this page's files into QQ, or package this page as a 7z (password-protected, auto-deleted after 1 hour) |

> You can install only the gallery to open the page, change settings, and view history cards, but **you cannot generate new images, and downloading and approving are unavailable**. Those capabilities belong to 刷Pixiv.

tempppw01/ledgerflow.body:
# LedgerFlow

AI-native workspace for long-term personal financial management: bookkeeping, budgeting, repayment, investing, and review, all in one place.

> **Note**
>
> Current version: `0.8.4`. The project is still iterating quickly, so keep backups of important data such as local JSON / WebDAV / OSS / MySQL snapshots.

> Note: The project is still in rapid iteration. Features, UI, and data structures will continue to change. Be sure to keep backups of important data, such as local JSON / WebDAV / OSS / MySQL snapshots.

> **Tip**
>
> **Recommended model API**: [ai.shuaihong.fun/v1](https://ai.shuaihong.fun/v1)  
> Many models are available, compatible with the OpenAI API, starting at 20 yuan per month. You can change the API endpoint to this service under "Settings → OpenAI" to connect more models to the AI assistant.

### 0.8.4 Highlights

- The repayment management page's charts and detail panel now support English: upcoming repayment trend, periods, principal/interest, estimated future interest, view period, more details, annualized ranking, estimated monthly payment, and about 40 other strings.
- Chart X-axis month labels now use `Intl.DateTimeFormat` to follow the language (Chinese `11月`, English `Nov`) instead of hardcoded Chinese month names. The year is automatically included when a range crosses years. Periods and repayment dates are also localized (`第 3 期` → `Period 3`, `25 日` → `25th`).
- As a result, `/repayment-management` in the English interface now only has Chinese in user data, such as debt names and notes.

### 0.8.3 Highlights

- The AI assistant page supports English: the welcome cards for all three modes (titles, descriptions, three capability notes, and this month's expense/income/balance summary) and the first greeting now follow the interface language. Dates and weekdays in the greeting use `Intl` localization instead of fixed Chinese.
- The repayment management page is fully translated to English: debt ratio labels (healthy / watch / high), all 8 status badges in the debt list (repaid this period, pending date, overdue, due today, due this period, etc.), monthly income sources, and the "needs confirmation" hint.
- Fixed a hidden localization coupling: when the AI credit butler input box gained focus, the code looked up the DOM using the Chinese string `textarea[aria-label="AI 信贷管家输入"]`. Once the aria-label follows the language, the element cannot be found in English. It now uses `ref` directly.
- The Chinese and English locales each have 2511 keys, and the key sets are identical.

```text
----------------------------------------
```

Supports macOS, Linux, Windows (native installers) · Fully local deployment; code and data stay on your own machine · Compatible with mainstream models such as Claude / DeepSeek / GLM / Qwen / Kimi / MiniMax 🔥 *Latest updates* 🔥 - [Nov 2026] **Let AI use WeCom / Feishu / DingTalk**: Click Activate, then scan the QR code or authorize, and AI can write documents and spreadsheets, send messages, and schedule calendars: [**Details**](https://docs.vibe-sellers.com/workplace-cli/) - [Nov 2026] **MCP integration**: In AI tools such as Claude, Codex, WorkBuddy, and Qoder, get Vibe Seller to work with a single sentence: [**Details**](https://docs.vibe-sellers.com/mcp/) - [Nov 2026] **Amazon Ads direct connection to Ads API**: The same ad optimization task went from 147 minutes to 11 minutes, with less manual intervention: [**Details**](https://docs.vibe-sellers.com/ads-api/) --- ## What is this Vibe Seller is a **browser automation framework** for cross-border sellers, deployed on your own computer. AI drives Ziniao or a regular Chrome via CDP (Chrome's low-level remote control protocol), and its actions on the page are the same as yours: ad optimization, listing, Listing inspection, inventory checks, tax invoice downloads, warehouse setup and inbound receiving, logistics tracking... Anything you can do in a browser can be handed to AI to execute. Each store is independent. **It's like hiring several operators, each responsible for their own area:** Store A's AI only uses Store A's Ziniao profile, has its own memory and workspace, and doesn't interfere with Store B or Store C. Data is isolated between them. ```mermaid flowchart LR U1[You] -.intranet.-> S U2[Colleague] -.intranet.-> S subgraph OfficeHost["Office computer (Mac, Linux, or Windows, always on)"] S[Vibe Seller service
Web dashboard :7777] S --> A1[Store A's Agent] S --> A2[Store B's Agent] S --> A3[Store C's Agent] A1 -->|CDP| Z1[Ziniao Store A] A2 -->|CDP| Z2[Ziniao Store B] A3 -->|CDP| C1[Regular Chrome] end ``` Choose one of two deployment options: - An **always-on office computer** running the Vibe Seller service; - Or use it directly on your own computer.
